listing.description_html:
List fixed and per-attendee costs, set the ticket price and fees, and see the break-even attendance, the break-even ticket price, and profit or loss at every attendance level up to capacity.

This planner separates fixed costs (venue, speakers, insurance) from per-attendee costs (catering, badges, swag), takes sponsorship off the fixed costs, and works out net revenue per ticket after percentage and per-ticket fees. It shows the contribution each attendee makes, the break-even attendance, the ticket price that breaks even at your expected attendance, and profit at ten attendance levels up to capacity.

What's included

  • Fixed and per-attendee costs, with sponsorship deducted
  • Net revenue per ticket after percentage and per-ticket fees
  • Break-even attendance and break-even ticket price
  • Profit or loss at ten attendance levels up to capacity
  • Flags cost lines with an unrecognised type instead of ignoring them silently
  • PDF guide with the formulas, a worked example and pricing tips

Who it's for

  • Meetup, workshop and conference organisers
  • Event planners pricing tickets for clients
  • Community groups and nonprofits running paid events
  • Venue owners hosting their own ticketed nights

You get: event_budget_ticket_breakeven_planner.xlsx (Settings, Costs, Attendance, Summary) and this guide.

Works in Excel 2016 or later, Excel for Mac and Excel on the web; opens in Google Sheets and LibreOffice.

This workbook is a planning tool, not financial, tax or legal advice. Ticketing fees, taxes and venue terms vary; check them with your ticketing provider, venue and accountant before you set prices.

pricing_evidence.basis: External observations read on 2026-10-29 through a web-search index plus internal Gumroad comparables.
